_note: Every event has one canonical UTC instant, rendered per source in its native convention. Whole org runs Asia/Bangkok (ICT, UTC+07, no DST).

sources.checkpoint_cef: rt=UTC epoch ms; syslog header ISO8601 with +07:00
sources.fortigate: date=/time= device LOCAL; tz=+0700; eventtime=UTC epoch ns
sources.linux_syslog_rfc3164: host LOCAL time (ICT), no offset shown
sources.panos: device LOCAL time (ICT), no offset in field or header
